        t."customerid",
        c."currency",

        "transactions_1k" t

        "customers" c ON t."customerid" = c."customerid"
    GROUP BY
        t."customerid", c."currency"
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        "customerid",
        "currency",
        total_price,
        total_amount,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_price DESC NULLS LAST) AS spending_rank

        customer_spending
)

    "customerid" AS top_spending_customer,
    (total_price / NULLIF(total_amount, 0)) AS average_price_per_item,
    "currency"
FROM
    ranked_customers
WHERE
    spending_rank = 1;

1482:
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        AND c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
segment_growth AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) AS increase,
        CASE
            WHEN consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012)::NUMERIC, 2)
        END AS percentage_increase
    FROM
        segment_growth
    WHERE
        consumption_2012 > 0
)
SELECT
    "segment" AS segment_with_biggest_increase,
    percentage_increase AS biggest_percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_change
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "segment" AS segment_with_lowest_increase,
    percentage_increase AS lowest_percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_change
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_2012 AS (
    SELECT
        t."customerid"
    FROM
        "transactions_1k" t
    WHERE
        t."date" = '2012-08-25'
        AND t."price" = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT
        ym."customerid",
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        customer_2012 c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    GROUP BY
        ym."customerid"
)
SELECT
    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM
    consumption_data;
